text:
maria_pm: Quick sync — Q3 tenant onboarding priorities. We have limited canary lanes (2), three hardware buckets, and a backlog of 18 tenants waiting for catalog entry. Need to decide acceptance gates + migration incentives by EOW.

# derek_eng: +1. What's must-have for the first wave? Perf benchmarks only? Or also pinning guarantees?

joni_research: Re: benchmarks — I can run a lightweight tenant-specific sample if we agree on a template. Suggest 50 queries (mix of chat, embed, and rerank) so we don't spike infra.

maria_pm: Must-haves I’m proposing: 95th/99th latency targets for short chat flows (<400ms p95, <700ms p99), embedding recall >0.88 on our cross-tenant benchmark, and compatibility with customers' quantized variants. For pinning: propose a soft-pin model — 30d by default, auto-migrate after unless a documented exception is requested.

raj_platform: Heads up — several sales-led customers have Dedicated capacity contracts that block auto-migration. We need an exception workflow surfaced in the onboarding form.

lisa_support: Customers keep asking for "no surprise" deprecations. Legal is pushing for a 60-day public notice minimum. Ops prefers 30d to reduce drift.

maria_pm: Tradeoff proposal: public notice = 60d (legal happy) but we provide hands-on migration assistance SLA for the first 30d post-notice. After 30d the tenant goes into our standard automation unless an exception is granted.

derek_eng: We also need explicit rollback criteria for canaries. My proposal: auto-rollback if any of the following occur during the 72h canary window: accuracy drop >6% on held prompt set OR sustained error rate >0.5% for 15m OR regression on top-10 customer intents.

joni_research: +1 on per-tenant held prompt sets — global metrics will hide tenant-specific regressions. I’ll add a tiny per-tenant eval harness that runs at canary start and every 6h.

maria_pm: Action items: Joni to define per-tenant sampling template and harness; Derek to spec canary lanes + rollback triggers and provide a config snippet; Raj to flag sales/AE for capacity & contract exceptions; Lisa to confirm legal accepts hybrid 60/30; I will draft the external comms and onboarding checklist.

deploy-bot: Staging canary slot available: Tue 03:00 UTC — reserve early if you need the lane.

derek_eng: Mock canary policy config (for discussion):
```
canary:
  lanes: 2
  duration_hours: 72
  metrics:
    latency_p95_ms: 400
    accuracy_drop_pct: 6
    error_rate_pct: 0.5
  per_tenant_eval: true
```

maria_pm: Incentives: propose a migration credit (one month free) for tenants that complete migration within 30d of deprecation notice. It should drive quicker cutovers and reduce exception requests.

lisa_support: Support is OK with offering credits; finance wants a rough cost estimate (per-tenant average token spend lost).

raj_platform: For large enterprises we should support a paid "pin exception": 90d soft-pin + prioritized migration engineering support for a fee. Prevents churn and gives revenue option.

derek_eng: One technical risk: some quantized models fail on our smallest hardware bucket. We can add a compatibility shim (fallback to a compatible variant) but it increases latency and cost. Need to document fallback routing in the onboarding checklist.

joni_research: I’ll include a quick compatibility matrix in the per-tenant report: model family -> quantization mode -> supported buckets. That will make exception triage faster.

maria_pm: Timeline: finalize gates + comms by Fri COB, pilot 10 tenants next Tue (use staging canary slots), then roll wave 1 in 4 weeks.

lisa_support: :thumbsup:

derek_eng: LGTM.

maria_pm: If nobody objects, I’ll update the onboarding doc and create calendar invites for the pilot tenants today.

lisa_support: Please include a short FAQ for customers about pinning and credits.

maria_pm: Will do — adding to action items. Thanks everyone.
